TC-06: User can see error message with i.description: Attempt login with invalid email/password and verify an error message is shown.

TC-07: User can successfully log in with.description: Log in using valid staging credentials and verify redirection to dashboard.

TC-09: Event selection and navigation.description: User can navigate from Events page to a specific event details page.
TC-09: Event selection and navigation.impact: Event browsing broken – users cannot see event details.

TC-10: Ticket quantity increase.description: User can increase the number of tickets for an event using the quantity button.
TC-10: Ticket quantity increase.impact: Ticket purchase flow blocked at quantity selection.

TC-11: Guest checkout initiation.description: After selecting tickets, the 'Guest Checkout' option appears and leads to the guest form.
TC-11: Guest checkout initiation.impact: Guest checkout unavailable, forcing account creation.

TC-12: Guest checkout form submission.description: Guest can fill all required fields (name, email, phone) and submit the order.

TC-13: Simulated payment success.description: User can pay using the test ‘Success - 1111’ card and proceed to confirmation.

TC-14: Success confirmation page.description: After successful payment, the congratulatory success page appears.
TC-14: Success confirmation page.impact: Order confirmation not shown – users may think purchase failed.

TC-15: Ticket viewing after purchase.description: User can view the purchased ticket details from the success page.
TC-15: Ticket viewing after purchase.impact: Ticket retrieval broken, users cannot access tickets.
